changes.description: Enhanced the analytics dashboard with new visitor charts, session tracking, and city-level geographic data.
Improved the tag management system with support for batch approvals and safer tag merging.
Resolved stability issues in the scraper pipeline to prevent data processing interruptions.
Updated the user documentation to reflect the latest application changes.
Updated the documentation portal to align with the latest technical specifications.
Upgraded the core SDK to the latest version to ensure platform stability.
Added support and user documentation for advanced batching and rate limiting features.
Improved log visibility by surfacing additional diagnostic fields from the chatbot plugin SDK.
Introduced a new administrative utility for backfilling RAG data pools.
Introduced a new search bar with real-time autocomplete suggestions for faster content discovery.
Implemented global search functionality to help users find specific articles within the application.
Added visual highlighting of matching keywords within search results for improved clarity.
Upgraded the article collection system to an asynchronous architecture for more efficient data updates.
Improved application performance and loading speeds by implementing a new frontend caching system.
Optimized article browsing and navigation to ensure a faster and more responsive user experience.
Introduced automated release notes to provide users with consistent and clear updates on application changes.
Expanded the data retrieval limits for research queries to allow for larger result sets.
Improved system performance and responsiveness by upgrading the core service integration.
Released version 1.5.0 featuring various platform-wide optimizations and updates.
Improved page load speeds by converting cover images to the WebP format.
Enhanced SEO and initial page load performance by implementing server-side rendering for public pages.
Improved application responsiveness with the addition of a new high-speed caching layer for data retrieval.
Updated the integrated chatbot plugin to the latest version for improved stability.
Added the ability to receive status notifications via Telegram for background data processing tasks.
Fixed a rendering issue where template characters were not properly escaped in the documentation site.
Updated the release documentation for the version 1.4.0 release.
Updated the application's internal version to 1.4.0.
Added typewriter-style animations for chat responses and new visual cards for tool calls
Resolved an issue where weekly reports failed to resume correctly within active chat conversations
Improved content management by separating pinned articles between the weekly report and general article views
Added an application filter to the monitoring dashboard to streamline data viewing
Fixed the close button on log detail dialogs so it remains visible while scrolling through content
Introduced themed scrollbars and improved error reporting via on-screen notification toasts
Cleaned up the settings interface by removing the non-functional email notification toggle
Optimized performance by eliminating duplicate data fetching and synchronization issues in the article list
Updated system deprecation warnings to provide clearer and more accurate information.
Improved error handling to provide more specific and helpful feedback for application errors.
Added a visual database schema diagram to the project documentation site.
Reorganized database architecture into logical domain-based schemas for better data management.
Published new technical documentation covering the latest database schema improvements.
Corrected the timeout measurement units to improve network connection reliability and application responsiveness.
Updated the application to version 1.2.2.
Rebranded the application from Scrape Analyzer to Article Analyzer.
Introduced an interactive guest tutorial featuring step-by-step highlights and localized content.
Added a button to the tutorial overlay that allows users to remain in Guest Mode.
Updated the navigation bar with a responsive design for better mobile device support.
Added a new tasks feature to the application.
Implemented role-based display logic to customize content visibility for different users.
Added new light and dark mode themes for the chat interface
Introduced an enhanced thinking chatbot UI with internationalization support
Implemented retry functionality for chatbot interactions
Added support for Markdown syntax rendering within the chat interface
Added a new RAG providers admin page for easier configuration and management
Fixed attachment UI issues and improved message source management
Resolved guest mode state persistence and errors during PDF processing
Added support for localized content and language settings across the application page.
Introduced translation support for titles, abstracts, and content sections.
Enabled the display of folder structures directly on information cards.
Enhanced the visual design and layout of the user interface.
Updated and refined the pipeline information tab for better clarity.
Fixed a display issue where certain navigation tabs appeared with a transparent background.
Improved the accuracy of source update timestamps to better reflect when content is checked for updates.
Optimized the release workflow to enable faster delivery of critical hotfixes and system updates.
Enhanced the internal verification process for stamped items to ensure improved data consistency.
Added support for OpenAlex data integration and original source tracking
Implemented Semantic Scholar integration for enhanced article insights
Added new article sharing capabilities and guest access mode
Initial release: RSS, ArXiv, and blog article scraping pipeline
Multi-provider LLM analysis with automatic fallback (Gemini, Claude, OpenRouter)
Admin panel for managing topics, scraper sources, and users
Automatic translation of analyses, tags, and tag groups into configured languages
Knowledge graph visualization with group and article nodes
Telegram notifications on pipeline completion with per-run stats
OpenTelemetry metrics and structured Loki logging across all pipeline stages
Added internationalization support for trace table columns and log dialogs.
GeoIP-based automatic language detection for frontend visitors
